summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo, but nothing was run, so all test results are unverified. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property based on finished_time, _reset clears it, capture in Progress.update and Progress.advance under the lock, new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with deferred imports and TYPE_CHECKING Table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (import, test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns, expected string regenerated by hand-tracing clock reads: start-frame bars 33->25 with elapsed 0:00:37/0:00:36, finished-frame bars 23->16 with captures 0:01:00/0:00:45, speeds now 1 byte/s for both rows). Verified by shell check that bar runs are 25/16 and every rendered row is 80 columns. Open points: reset with completed==total both clears (per the reset clear rule) and does not capture; BarColumn finished styling does not follow Task.finished because ProgressBar compares completed to total; docs not updated. Nothing committed.
